title: 3D ops on a small mould core take 5-13 min, adaptive silently falls back to Offset rings (warnings=0), and a Waterline generate over 900 s blocks every other MCP call

body:
Found by the release QA swarm (#2582) on **v0.24.0**, driven through `camcraft-cli mcp` by a Codex agent (len, 8 cores, load ~6, nice 10). Part: small mould core 80 x 60 x 30 (half-ellipsoid boss, R2 root fillet, R3 runner), imported as a 22824-facet STL (STEP route blocked, #3034). Tormach 770MX, stock 84 x 64 x 32.

## What happens
1. **3D Pocket, strategy adaptive**, Ø12 flat, stepdown 2, stepover 2, leave 0.3: **334 s**. Six levels hit the planning budget, eight more self-cross, and all of those fall back to Offset rings - but the op reports status ok and **warnings=0**; the fallback is only in the notes:
   `adaptive: the HSM plan is refused: growing the cleared area ran past its planning budget after 57 revolutions ... ~607.9 k outline vertices processed (limit 600 k) ... - Offset rings cut the level at Z 28.000 instead`
2. **Rest 3D Pocket** with a Ø6 ball (rest_rough): **765 s**, same fallbacks.
3. **finish3d pattern waterline**, Ø6 ball, tolerance 0.05: no answer after **900 s** (MCP client timeout). A `save_project` and a read-only `get_job` queued behind it also time out at 900 s each: the server serves nothing while one generate runs, and there is no cancel tool. The run ended without a saved Rest6 result or a post.

## Expected
Toolpaths for a part this size in well under a minute (or a refusal naming the budget); a fallback that replaces most of the requested strategy is a warning, not a note; a long generate does not block save/read calls, or can be cancelled.

## Reproduce (on len)
`/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q02-3d-mold/q02-3d-mold.camproj` (STL model) -> `open_project`, `generate {name:"Rough12"}`, `generate {name:"Rest6"}`, `generate {name:"Waterline6"}`. Op parameters: `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q02-3d-mold/evidence-57.json`; results `evidence-55.json`, `-69`, `-70`, `-76`, `-83`, `-85`; report `/home/mikekinney/qa/runs/20261120-q02-3d-mold/REPORT.md` (problems 3 and 5).

Related: #5, #882, #1950.

Not checked on current main.

Done means: Rough12, Rest6 and Waterline6 on this part each finish within a stated budget (or refuse with a reason), the adaptive fallback raises a warning, and a long generate no longer blocks other MCP calls (or can be cancelled); pinned by tests.
